details.text: The standalone `PATCH` master at `src/client/public/media/homepage/patch-wordmark.svg` remains a valid asset. The two series lockups below are additive peers: neither is intrinsically primary or secondary, and the appropriate treatment is chosen in situ. They are stored together with their deterministic construction and use guide so that the package can migrate intact to a dedicated Adventures repository later.

items: Disciplined control: `src/client/public/brand/adventures-of-patch/adventures-of-patch-control.svg` (`viewBox="0 0 340 121.7617"`, 13,670 bytes, SHA-256 `b255ad214e4e3616003b5d3d83da4af68ed74d8a2c120fa18edab90c9eca0ca9`). `Adventures` starts at the one-percent optical inset and resolves on the right edge of T; `of` terminates on the sharp right edge of C; H remains free; the strapline sits five units above PATCH.

Cliff drop: `src/client/public/brand/adventures-of-patch/adventures-of-patch-cliff-drop.svg` (`viewBox="0 0 340 126.2021"`, 14,281 bytes, SHA-256 `ef476351980a835195967a88c1807e1c2bbb027c706ad9e6d0d3313c7aff0ef0`). The T edge is the cliff. The final `s` moves vertically only: its top resolves to the upper edge of the preceding `e` crossbar and its bottom resolves to the PATCH cap datum. `of` still terminates on C and H remains free.

Homepage use: the Specialists movement uses the cliff-drop lockup as its small series marque. It is loaded through the base-path-safe brand helper, inherits the composition colour through `currentColor`, and retains a 132 px or larger rendered width at the supported breakpoints. The standalone PATCH master remains available for contexts that call for the master wordmark alone.

Outlined construction: PATCH is ITC Serif Gothic Std Black and the strapline is ITC Serif Gothic Std ExtraBold, both `Version 2.000 Build 1000`, designed by Herb Lubalin and Antonio DiSpigna and manufactured by Monotype ITC Inc. Each SVG contains exactly one compound path with `currentColor`; it contains no `<text>`, font binary, subset, encoded font data, webfont, local-font link, transform, or separately addressable letter path. The indivisible path is the distributable artwork.

Licence basis: both faces were purchased from MyFonts / Monotype and verified on 3 September 2026 against the Monotype Font Software For Desktop End User License Agreement v250903 supplied in Harley Bartles' locally retained order archives. That evidence authorises static graphic material when the font software is not embedded and glyphs are not individually addressable. Order identifiers, purchase paperwork and font binaries remain private and are not repository assets. This record makes no webfont or font-serving claim.

Brand guide: `src/client/public/brand/adventures-of-patch/adventures-of-patch-brand-guide.pdf` (six A4 landscape pages, 44,985 bytes, SHA-256 `bd570733877a49ca2c8f59192ab05527540f0ddbdf85570d21a8814566b31d41`). It records hierarchy, asset roles, both constructions, the cliff-drop story, the datum-spaghetti rejection rule, realistic-size comparisons including the established 132 px check, restrained colour guidance, banned treatments, licensing and migration custody. Its PDF font inventory contains only non-embedded Base-14 Helvetica, Helvetica Bold and Times Roman; every brand mark is drawn from the committed static outlines.
